title: Great night!
text: Really a great evening with Claire, our Francophone guide. Everything was great, whether it was the guided tour, the tapas tastings and the flamenco show. We highly recommend.
author: Nurbo01

title: Flamenco night and Tapas
text: For me the best thing I have experienced in Sevilla. Our guide and dancer Constanza was amazing, she is such a kind, professional person with a big passion for flamenco. She also told us a lot of interesting things about Triana (part of Seville). The whole evening was great. We were looking for something authentic and we definitely found it. Thank you
author: Michaela N

title: A Memorable Experience
text: Our guide/dancer, Lulu, was a delightful person who speaks excellent English, among others. She met us and we were off to three tapas bars where she bought drinks & tapas for us, and talked about the Flamenco life and history. We soon developed an easy conversation that continued through the evening. Then we went to the site of the show, a local bar with a small stage.  We sat on chairs on three sides and up close to the dancer & musicians. They put on a terrific show, so intimate, and the passion of the performers could be seen easily. title: Amazing tour
text: Maria was amazing! She took us to an incredible show that was small and intimate so you could actually see the performers. Introduced us to some amazing tapas and drinks. She got us to try food we normally wouldn't try and we loved it. She gave us tons of information about the history of Flamanco and of Seville. She was extremely friendly. I would definitely do this tour with her again. She has years and years or experience as a Flamanco dancer and it shows with her knowledge.
author: K6618SLkevinn
